lines.2: 「The Tsushima family will continue searching for and recruiting new talent.」
lines.4: Shinichi spread the first-year roster out right there.
lines.5: 「Now then, who should we grace with an invitation first?」
lines.6: 「You pick these things with your sixth sense. Oh! Found a good name! How about this girl from Class 1-B?」
lines.9: 「I seriously can't believe you got into this school. Even I can read that.」
lines.11: 「With a name like Nagomi, she's gotta be soothing, right? Just reading it soothed my heart.」
lines.14: 「Without a busy club to use as an excuse, she'll be more likely to accept.」
lines.16: 「Do put in a reasonable effort. And try not to cause any trouble.」
lines.17: 「Yashi makes me think of the tropics. I bet she's got a warm, sunny heart.」
lines.18: 「And true to her name, her body will be sweet as fruit.」
lines.19: 「Then she'll cleanse my weary heart in this garbage dump of a world.」
lines.20: 「The world's not the garbage dump here. Fukahire is the actual garbage.」
lines.23: 「Ow! Don't punch a lady with your fist!」
lines.24: 「Let's get moving. Even if she's in the go-home club, there's still a good chance she'll be in her classroom.」
lines.26: We marched out of the student council room.
lines.27: 「Now then, maybe I'll go see how they handle the job.」
lines.29: 「Of course. Yesterday we got a report about a bespectacled, monkey-faced second-year staring at first-year girls like a wild animal by the school gate. That doesn't inspire much confidence.」
lines.30: 「I'll just watch from behind without saying anything.」
lines.32: 「Hey, first-years! Is Nagomi Yashi here? Point her out if she is.」
lines.34: 「Why did they all frown the second they heard Nagomi Yashi's name?」
